lines.transliteration: mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੀ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਇ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabad ratee sohaaganee satigur kai bhaai piaar ||
lines.translation: The happy soul-bride is attuned to the Word of the Shabad; she is in love with the True Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਰਾਵੇ ਪਿਰੁ ਆਪਣਾ ਸਚੈ ਪ੍ਰੇਮਿ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: sadaa raave pir aapanaa sachai prem piaar ||
lines.translation: She continually enjoys and ravishes her Beloved, with true love and affection.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਤਿ ਸੁਆਲਿਉ ਸੁੰਦਰੀ ਸੋਭਾਵੰਤੀ ਨਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: at suaaliu su(n)daree sobhaava(n)tee naar ||
lines.translation: She is such a loveable, beautiful and noble woman.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਮੇਲੀ ਮੇਲਣਹਾਰਿ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak naam sohaaganee melee melanahaar ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, through the Naam, the happy soul-bride unites with the Lord of Union. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਭ ਕਰਹਿ ਉਸਤਤਿ ਜਿਨਿ ਫਾਥੇ ਕਾਢਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: har teree sabh karahi usatat jin phaathe kaadhiaa ||
lines.translation: Lord, everyone sings Your Praises. You have freed us from bondage.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਕਰਹਿ ਸਭ ਨਮਸਕਾਰੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਪਾਪੈ ਤੇ ਰਾਖਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: har tudhano karahi sabh namasakaar jin paapai te raakhiaa ||
lines.translation: Lord, everyone bows in reverence to You. You have saved us from our sinful ways.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਿਮਾਣਿਆ ਤੂੰ ਮਾਣੁ ਹਰਿ ਡਾਢੀ ਹੂੰ ਤੂੰ ਡਾਢਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: har nimaaniaa too(n) maan har daadhee hoo(n) too(n) daadhiaa ||
lines.translation: Lord, You are the Honor of the dishonored. Lord, You are the Strongest of the strong.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੀਆ ਮਾਰਿ ਨਿਵਾਏ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮੂੜ ਸਾਧਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: har aha(n)kaareeaa maar nivaae manamukh mooR saadhiaa ||
lines.translation: The Lord beats down the egocentrics and corrects the foolish, self-willed manmukhs.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਾ ਦੇਇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਗਰੀਬ ਅਨਾਥਿਆ ॥੧੭॥
lines.transliteration: har bhagataa dei vadiaaee gareeb anaathiaa ||17||
lines.translation: The Lord bestows glorious greatness on His devotees, the poor, and the lost souls. ||17||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਜੋ ਚਲੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਵਡੀ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur kai bhaanai jo chalai tis vadiaaee vadee hoi ||
lines.translation: One who walks in harmony with the Will of the True Guru, obtains the greatest glory.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਉਤਮੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਮੇਟਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: har kaa naam utam man vasai met na sakai koi ||
lines.translation: The Exalted Name of the Lord abides in his mind, and no one can take it away.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਜਿਸੁ ਆਪਣੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਕਰਮਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: kirapaa kare jis aapanee tis karam paraapat hoi ||
lines.translation: That person, upon whom the Lord bestows His Grace, receives His Mercy.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਾਰਣੁ ਕਰਤੇ ਵਸਿ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝੈ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak kaaran karate vas hai guramukh boojhai koi ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, creativity is under the control of the Creator; how rare are those who, as Gurmukh, realize this! ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਿਨੀ ਆਰਾਧਿਆ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਤਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: naanak har naam jinee aaraadhiaa anadin har liv taar ||
lines.translation: O Nanak, those who worship and adore the Lord's Name night and day, vibrate the String of the Lord's Love.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਬੰਦੀ ਖਸਮ ਕੀ ਤਿਨ ਅਗੈ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਕਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: maaiaa ba(n)dee khasam kee tin agai kamaavai kaar ||
lines.translation: Maya, the maid-servant of our Lord and Master, serves them.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੂਰੈ ਪੂਰਾ ਕਰਿ ਛੋਡਿਆ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਸਵਾਰਣਹਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: poorai pooraa kar chhodiaa hukam savaaranahaar ||
lines.translation: The Perfect One has made them perfect; by the Hukam of His Command, they are embellished.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਜਿਨਿ ਬੁਝਿਆ ਤਿਨਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur parasaadee jin bujhiaa tin paaiaa mokh duaar ||
lines.translation: By Guru's Grace, they understand Him, and they find the gate of salvation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ ਤਿਨ ਮਾਰੇ ਜਮ ਜੰਦਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: manamukh hukam na jaananee tin maare jam ja(n)daar ||
lines.translation: The self-willed manmukhs do not know the Lord's Command; they are beaten down by the Messenger of Death.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਿਨੀ ਅਰਾਧਿਆ ਤਿਨੀ ਤਰਿਆ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh jinee araadhiaa tinee tariaa bhaujal sa(n)saar ||
lines.translation: But the Gurmukhs, who worship and adore the Lord, cross over the terrifying world-ocean.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਅਉਗਣ ਗੁਣੀ ਮਿਟਾਇਆ ਗੁਰੁ ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਣਹਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: sabh augan gunee mitaaiaa gur aape bakhasanahaar ||2||
lines.translation: All their demerits are erased, and replaced with merits. The Guru Himself is their Forgiver. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਭਗਤਾ ਪਰਤੀਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਭ ਕਿਛੁ ਜਾਣਦਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: har kee bhagataa parateet har sabh kichh jaanadaa ||
lines.translation: The Lord's devotees have faith in Him. The Lord knows everything.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋਈ ਜਾਣੁ ਹਰਿ ਧਰਮੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਦਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: har jevad naahee koee jaan har dharam beechaaradaa ||
lines.translation: No one is as great a Knower as the Lord; the Lord administers righteous justice.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾੜਾ ਅੰਦੇਸਾ ਕਿਉ ਕੀਜੈ ਜਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਅਧਰਮਿ ਮਾਰਦਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaaRaa a(n)desaa kiu keejai jaa naahee adharam maaradaa ||
lines.translation: Why should we feel any burning anxiety, since the Lord does not punish without just cause?

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਚੁ ਨਿਆਉ ਪਾਪੀ ਨਰੁ ਹਾਰਦਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: sachaa saahib sach niaau paapee nar haaradaa ||
lines.translation: True is the Master, and True is His Justice; only the sinners are defeated.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਲਾਹਿਹੁ ਭਗਤਹੁ ਕਰ ਜੋੜਿ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤ ਜਨ ਤਾਰਦਾ ॥੧੮॥
lines.transliteration: saalaahihu bhagatahu kar joR har bhagat jan taaradaa ||18||
lines.translation: O devotees, praise the Lord with your palms pressed together; the Lord saves His humble devotees. ||18||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪਣੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹਾ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਰਖਾ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: aapane preetam mil rahaa a(n)tar rakhaa ur dhaar ||
lines.translation: Oh, if only I could meet my Beloved, and keep Him enshrined deep within my heart!

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਹੇਤਿ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: saalaahee so prabh sadaa sadaa gur kai het piaar ||
lines.translation: I praise that God forever and ever, through love and affection for the Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਸੁ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਮੇਲਿ ਲਏ ਸਾਈ ਸੁਹਾਗਣਿ ਨਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak jis nadar kare tis mel lae saaee suhaagan naar ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, that one upon whom He bestows His Glance of Grace is united with Him; such a person is the true soul-bride of the Lord. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur sevaa te har paaeeai jaa kau nadar karei ||
lines.translation: Serving the Guru, the Lord is obtained, when He bestows His Glance of Grace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਣਸ ਤੇ ਦੇਵਤੇ ਭਏ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: maanas te devate bhae dhiaaiaa naam hare ||
lines.translation: They are transformed from humans into angels, meditating on the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਅਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਤਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: haumai maar milaaian gur kai sabad tare ||
lines.translation: They conquer their egotism and merge with the Lord; they are saved through the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਇਅਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਣੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak sahaj samaaian har aapanee kripaa kare ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, they merge imperceptibly into the Lord, who has bestowed His Favor upon them. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਆਪਣੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਾਇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਵੇਖਾਲੀਅਨੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: har aapanee bhagat karaai vadiaaee vekhaaleean ||
lines.translation: The Lord Himself inspires us to worship Him; He reveals His Glorious Greatness.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪਣੀ ਆਪਿ ਕਰੇ ਪਰਤੀਤਿ ਆਪੇ ਸੇਵ ਘਾਲੀਅਨੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: aapanee aap kare parateet aape sev ghaaleean ||
lines.translation: He Himself inspires us to place our faith in Him. Thus He performs His Own Service.
